title: RQG Item - skill
description: Generated JSON Schema for the "skill" Item DataModel's `system` data. Source: src/data-model/item-data/skill-data-model.ts. Do not edit by hand — run `pnpm generate:schemas`.

canGetExperience.title: Can get experience
canGetExperience.description: Whether the ability can be checked for an experience gain.

hasExperience.title: Has experience
hasExperience.description: Set when the ability has earned an experience check. Cleared when the improvement is rolled.

descriptionRqidLink.title: Description
descriptionRqidLink.description: Link to the journal entry that describes the skill.

category.title: Category
category.description: The skill category. The character's modifier for the category applies to the skill.

skillName.title: Skill name
skillName.description: Name of the skill, without the specialization.

specialization.title: Specialization
specialization.description: The specialization, for example the weapon or language.

gainedChance.title: Gained chance
gainedChance.description: Percentage points gained from experience, training and research.

runeRqidLinks.title: Runes
runeRqidLinks.description: Links to the runes that can affect the skill.

categoryMod.title: Category modifier
categoryMod.description: The character's modifier for this skill's category. Calculated, never stored.

chance.title: Chance
chance.description: The chance used when rolling: base and gained chance plus the category modifier and other modifiers. Calculated, never stored.
